_comment: Provenance for every PUBLIC pretrained model used by SkinTypeAI's multi-condition analysis. Nothing here was trained by this project. Metrics are ATTRIBUTED to their source (see metric_provenance) and are not independently reproduced unless noted. Mirrors models/skin_analysis/registry.py.
runtime: CPU only (no NVIDIA GPU on the dev machine)

skin_type.training_data: Kaggle 'Oily, Dry and Normal Skin Types' dataset (facial photos)
skin_type.reported_metrics: accuracy 0.653, macro-F1 0.653 on a 1529-image test split
skin_type.metric_provenance: author-reported (classification report in model card + linked Kaggle notebook)
skin_type.verified_by_this_project: loads and runs on CPU (~0.5s/image); low confidence on this project's spot-check selfies (task is inherently fuzzy)

acne_severity.training_data: not named in card; levels align with ACNE04 Hayashi grading
acne_severity.verified_by_this_project: returned 'level 3' for a severe ACNE04 test image and 'level -1' (clear) for a clean selfie

acne_detector.training_data: 'acne_unified' (~1843 images / 18717 boxes; box count ~= ACNE04 -> likely ACNE04-derived)
acne_detector.verified_by_this_project: at conf 0.25: 4-6 boxes on severe ACNE04 test images, 0 boxes on a clean selfie (no fabricated detections). Replaces the abandoned 3-epoch ACNE04 proof model.

wrinkle_segmenter.architecture: U-Net with ResNet50 encoder (model code vendored under models/skin_analysis/wrinkle_unet/, MIT)
wrinkle_segmenter.output: wrinkle probability mask -> reduced to a wrinkle-area fraction
wrinkle_segmenter.license: code MIT; WEIGHTS and training data CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (FFHQ-Wrinkle dataset)
wrinkle_segmenter.commercial_use_note: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - non-commercial only. Acceptable for this academic project; must NOT ship as a product.
wrinkle_segmenter.training_data: FFHQ-Wrinkle: 1000 manually labelled wrinkle masks (+ 50k weak) on FFHQ face images
wrinkle_segmenter.verified_by_this_project: state_dict loads with 0 missing / 0 unexpected keys; ~0 wrinkle fraction on young faces. Positive-case accuracy NOT independently validated.

redness_heuristic.source_url: own code; approach inspired by https://github.com/DurtyDhiana/skin-scan (MIT)
redness_heuristic.method: CIELAB a* statistics on the mediapipe/opencv-detected skin region
redness_heuristic.reason: no public facial-redness detection model or dataset exists (verified over 3 audit rounds)

pores_heuristic.source_url: own code; approach inspired by https://github.com/DurtyDhiana/skin-scan (MIT)
pores_heuristic.method: black-hat morphology blob density on the skin region
pores_heuristic.reason: no public facial-pore detection model or dataset exists

not_available.pigmentation: No validated public model or facial box/mask dataset. Dermoscopy sets are the wrong domain; the rest are image-level or unlicensed.
not_available.blackheads: No working public comedone/blackhead detector for facial photos (best candidate scored mAP50 ~0.14; ACNE-DET dataset is 276 images, not public).
